control_flow: driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, curve right; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line in bright light, drive straight through a dark tunnel without touching its walls, and follow the line again after the tunnel.

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads below 70 %

branches.outcome: the light is dim: it curves right at 40 % and 20 %
the light is bright: it calls stopAtWall

decision_points.condition: the front obstacle sensor sees something

branches.outcome: an obstacle is ahead: it stops
no obstacle ahead: it calls followLine
it sees black: it curves left at 10 % and 40 %
it does not see black: it curves right at 40 % and 10 %

scenarios.coded_response: In bright light it checks for an obstacle; with none, it curves left when the line tracker sees black and curves right when it does not.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is on a line in bright light, with no obstacle ahead, and the line has at least one bend.
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker sees black, then not black, again and again.
scenarios.title: Follows the line in bright light
assumptions: You did not say where the line ends, so its end is taken as the goal.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line to its end.

scenarios.coded_response: It stops while the obstacle is ahead; without an obstacle it follows the line.
scenarios.initial_condition: In bright light, an obstacle stands across the robot's path.
scenarios.trigger: The front obstacle sensor sees the obstacle.
scenarios.title: Stops at an obstacle in bright light
assumptions: You did not say this, but your program stops when the front obstacle sensor sees something in bright light.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It stops before the obstacle without bumping into it, and stays there while it is ahead.

scenarios.coded_response: While the light is dim it curves right at 40 % and 20 %, without reading the obstacle or line sensor; once bright again it checks for an obstacle and then follows the line.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is in a dark tunnel in dim light, with no line under it, centered and facing along the tunnel; after the tunnel there is a line in bright light.
scenarios.trigger: The left light sensor reads below 70 %.
scenarios.title: Drives through a dark tunnel and follows the line again
assumptions: You did not say how wide the tunnel is or where exactly the line after it runs.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It drives straight through the dark tunnel without touching its walls, and follows the line again after the tunnel.

uncertainties: In dim light your program curves right, not straight, and never reads the obstacle sensor: it may bump into a tunnel wall.
In bright light your program stops at an obstacle, but in the dark it never checks for one.
The program on a plain floor circles right, so in bright light it needs a line under it to follow the line.
You did not say where the line after the tunnel is, so when it comes out of the dark it may miss it.
